guide_solution: (a) Where there is a will, there is a way. (b) If a man does not work hard, he will fail to prosper in life. (c) As the people of Bangladesh are hard working, Bangladesh is progressing remarkably. (d) About a decade ago Bangladesh was slow in development, but now she has made a remarkable development in her G.D.P. (e) So, it is our bounden duty to sustain and carry out this development at any cost.
